searchText: The editors may allow direct to review. I would just do the path you said though, just to avoid any conflict. You will need editor approval for any status change. I went stagnant -> review earlier this year https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/4925 so I think it will be fine, unless it is a new policy
